description: Use this when the user wants an existing image changed: edit it by instruction, upscale, remove the background, enhance, erase something, restyle, colorize, restore, expand the canvas, or make a variation. Saves the result as a new image in their Xenition library; the original is kept.

image.description: https URL of the image to edit (e.g. from create_image)

operation.description: one of: edit, upscale, background-removal, enhance, erase, stylize, colorize, restore, expand, variation

prompt.description: what to change, for edit / erase / stylize

name: edit_image
title: Edit an image
